query:
-- 1. Archive claims with no tenant_id (set status to 'archived', mark as orphaned)
UPDATE claims 
SET status = 'archived', 
    workflowState = 'closed',
    updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE tenantId IS NULL 
  AND status NOT IN ('archived', 'closed');

-- 2. Clean up dangling approval records (approvals referencing non-existent claims)
DELETE FROM approval_chain_records 
WHERE claimId NOT IN (SELECT id FROM claims);

-- 3. Verify results
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims WHERE tenantId IS NULL) as orphan_claims_remaining,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_chain_records acr LEFT JOIN claims c ON acr.claimId = c.id WHERE c.id IS NULL) as dangling_approvals_remaining;
